summary: This bill allows individuals to enroll in standalone dental plans offered through federal health care exchanges without also having to enroll in a qualified health plan.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to increase access to standalone dental plans through Federal Exchanges by allowing individuals to enroll without also enrolling in a qualified health plan. This expands options within the existing healthcare framework, leaning towards private insurance access rather than public healthcare expansion.

The bill's sole purpose is to amend the ACA to permit standalone dental plan enrollment on Federal Exchanges without requiring simultaneous enrollment in a qualified health plan, directly expanding access to dental coverage through the government-run exchange system.
